title: CELLULOID
models: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1) wrote the code, the assets and the critiques
no image or sound generator: every sound is synthesised at runtime from the physics
what_i_found: The paddle is a real racket, not a bat: a hollow 2.7 g ball with drag and spin-parameter Magnus lift meets competition rubber modelled as grip, slip and tangential restitution, so a flick of the mouse at contact is a brush and a brush is spin you can see in the ball's band and trail. The wrist is set for you like a coach sets a beginner's, closing as you rise and opening as you drop, so a novice can rally while a charged swing from the wrong height still goes long, exactly as it would on a real table. The three opponents plan their shots with the same integrator the ball flies by, an order of magnitude apart in reach, reaction and error.
